resources.string: Automates the daily Sudha order entry

SudhaAutoBot drives the third-party app \"Sudha Daily Orders\" for you: it opens Customers, finds every SMR retailer, copies the previous order from up to 3 days back and places the order. It never sends anything off the device and it only acts inside the package you configure.

1. Enable the accessibility service.
2. Grant "Display over other apps".
3. Enter the target package and save.
4. Open the bus app, sign in, sit on the home screen.
5. Show the floating panel and press ▶ START.

• The bot is a UI macro. It types nothing, buys nothing and only taps what is described in the request.\n• Keep \"Auto-join\" off on Oppo/Vivo; the panel needs to stay pinned.\n• Anyone with the accessibility permission can read screens. Only enable it for apps you trust.
